title: Find Distance in a Binary Tree
summary: Given a binary tree's root and two node values p and q, calculate the number of edges on the path between the nodes with values p and q.
statement: Given a binary tree's root and two node values p and q, calculate the number of edges on the path between the nodes with values p and q.
constraints: Tree node values are unique, and p and q are values present in the tree.
Return the number of edges on the shortest path between those two nodes.

def binary_tree_value_distance(root, p, q):
 def path(node,target,route):
  if not node:return False
  route.append(node.val)
  if node.val==target:return True
  if path(node.left,target,route) or path(node.right,target,route):return True
  route.pop();return False
